children: Indonesian state-owned plantation company Agrinas Palma Nusantara is targeting palm oil output of 1.5 million metric tons next year, chief executive Mohamad Abdul Ghani told reporters on Thursday.
Agrinas Palma Nusantara's output this year is estimated at 900,000 tons, Ghani said, and expected to rise to 1.5 million tons in 2027.
⁠Ghani did not provide details on the factors behind the expected increase in output.
While Agrinas Palma manages around 3 million hectares of land, the company said only about 730,000 hectares are under oil palm cultivation.
